title: The query log's distill finds an item's sprint in kb/_self/backlog, not in the project's item_dir
goal: ql_distill reads the item files that name each item's sprint from the project's item_dir (bl_base.rel_dir()), not from the constant kb/_self/backlog, so a project whose item files are in _backlog/ gets its sprint figures in cost; the repro exits 0

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_base, ql_distill; bl_base._LOADED[:] = [({'item_dir': '_backlog'}, {}, None, [])]; sys.exit(0 if ql_distill.BACKLOG_REL == bl_base.rel_dir() else 1)
